title: PersonaPack
description: personas/<slug>/persona.yaml. Custom packs cannot change schema, escalation caps or quiet-hour rules (invariant 6).

intensity.description: Escalation style, 0 = gentle, 3 = drill sergeant. Capped by code.

quiet_hours.description: Extra quiet hours for this persona; config quiet hours always apply too.

owns.description: Categories this persona hands out by default.

priority.description: Tie-break when several personas own a category; higher wins.
